 Introduction 
 Sri Meenakshi Government Arts College for Women(A) was established by the Government of Tamilnadu in the temple city of Madurai in the year 1965, to fulfill the need for the upliftment of women in and around Madurai. Set in a sprawling campus of 16 acres, the college began its journey with 320 students and 13 teaching and 13 non-teaching staff members. Today, the college stands upgraded to Grade-I status and is well-placed among the 14 Grade-I colleges in the state of Tamil Nadu.

 Our Courses 
 Tamil 
 The Department of Tamil was established in the year 1966. In addition to offering part-I Tamil to all the students of the undergraduate program, the Department also offers B.A., Tamil & M.A., Tamil. B. A Tamil has been offered since 1966 and an M.A Tamil has been offered since 2013.
 View More 
 English 
 The Department of English, the pride of the Institution, has been part of it, ever since its inception and has a rich heritage of 50 years of service in teaching English at the Part II level. It looks with pride at the accomplished track record set over the years by the enthusiastic faculty members.
 View More 
 History 
 The Department of History was established in 1969 with an undergraduate course in History In 1975 M.A History was introduced. In 2014, the department was upgraded to a Research Department with M.Phil and Ph.D. (Full-time and Part-time) programs. Our Department has 13 sanctioned faculty positions. Among them, 10 faculty members possess a Doctorate Degree.
 View More 
 Economics 
 The Department of Economics came in to being as a distinct unit in 1966-67. The Department started UG Course in 1966-67, Post-Graduate Course in 1975-76 and M.Phil in 2013-14.The Department of Economics is one of the oldest of the Departments in the college and it has made a qualitative contribution to research and under and post graduate education in Economics since its initiation.
 View More 
 Commerce 
 The Department of Commerce was established as a separate entity in [Year — please provide if known]. The Department introduced the Undergraduate Programme in [UG Year], the Postgraduate Programme in [PG Year], and began offering M.Phil. in [M.Phil Year]. As one of the longstanding departments of the college, the Department of Commerce has consistently contributed to academic excellence through its dedicated focus on teaching, learning, and research in commerce and business-related disciplines.
 View More 
 Mathematics 
 The Department of Mathematics has been offering B.Sc Mathematics since 1966 and M.Sc Mathematics since 1980. The department has an enterprising faculty team and an enriched academic ambiance for the students. Six of the faculty have a Ph.D. Three of them are recognized research guides of Madurai Kamaraj University.
 View More 
 Physics 
 The Department of UG Physics was established in the year 1970-71 and PG Physics in 2013-14 with full strength. The department strives to provide quality education to make the students competent in all aspects with the help of well-qualified, committed, and experienced faculty members.
 View More 
 Chemistry 
 Chemistry is the most fascinating subject that deals with every aspect of our life. It nurtures students from various disciplines and hence has been a subject of maximum demand. The knowledge gained through the study of chemistry opens many career pathways.
 View More 
 Botany 
 There was a humble beginning of the Botany department with only Ancillary subjects. The then Botanical faculty intended that knowledge of plant science is necessarily infused in the minds of students. Thereby everyone understood what is what about Botany. Later on in the year 1995,
 View More 
 Zoology 
 The Department of Zoology was established in the year 1971 with Tamil and English as a medium of instruction. With 50 students at the beginning, the department has been flourishing for the past 48 years imparting knowledge, social skills, and ethics. The department is keen on providing a synergistic environment for academic upliftment and accepting social changes.
 View More 
 Geography 
 The Department of Geography was established in the year 1968 with a UG course and in the year in 1971 with a PG course. At present department has 6 Regular staff members 2 Guest Lecturers and 1 PTA Guest Lecturers and 259 UG and 29 PG students among its various academic ventures. It produces so many scholars and creates more professionals in various fields.
 View More 
 Home Science 
 The Department of Home Science with its early beginnings in 1979-1980 has offered a B.Sc. Home Science with specialization in Child Care and Preschool Education till 1999-2000. Keeping in view the bright career prospects in the health, nutrition, and food industries, the department reframed the curriculum and offered a B.Sc.
 View More 
 Computer Science 
 The Department of Computer Science was established in the year 1993 with a B.SC in Computer Science. In the academic year 2007-2008, B.Sc Computer Science (Shift II) was started and introduced M.Sc Computer Science in 2017, M. Phil Computer Science, and Ph.D. Computer Science during the academic year 2018 – 2019.
 View More 
 Computer Applications 
 The Department of Computer Applications blossomed in the year 1998 offering a Master of Computer Applications course approved by AICTE. In August 2018 BCA course was started. The Department has an enterprising faculty team of 3 Assistant professors . 2 Guest faculties and 1 programmer. It has more than 100 research publications to its credit.
 View More 
 Business Administration 
 BBA program Was introduced in a Academic year 2017-18 of Sri Meenakshi Govt. Arts College for Women(A) was initiated in the year 2004 with a broad vision to impart management knowledge by continuous updating of syllabi and interaction with corporations for enhancing employability among rural women students.

 Objectives of IQAC
  
 To develop a system for continuous improvement in academic and administrative performance.
  
 To promote quality enhancement initiatives and institutionalize best practices.
  
 To ensure stakeholder satisfaction through high-quality education and services.
  
 To prepare the institution for national and international accreditation.
  
 To foster innovation, research, and development in teaching and learning.
  
 To organize capacity-building programs for faculty and staff.
  
 To establish effective feedback mechanisms for quality improvement.
  
 To ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
 Functions of IQAC
 Quality Assurance: Monitoring and evaluating academic and administrative processes to ensure quality standards.
 Accreditation: Facilitating the institution’s preparation for NAAC, NBA, and other accreditation processes.
 Feedback Mechanisms: Collecting and analyzing feedback from students, faculty, and stakeholders for continuous improvement.
 Documentation: Maintaining records of quality-related activities and initiatives
 Training and Development: Organizing workshops, seminars, and training programs for faculty and staff.
 Best Practices: Identifying and implementing innovative practices to enhance institutional performance.
 Research Promotion: Encouraging research activities that contribute to academic excellence.

 Objectives of IQAC
  
 To develop a system for continuous improvement in academic and administrative performance.
  
 To promote quality enhancement initiatives and institutionalize best practices.
  
 To ensure stakeholder satisfaction through high-quality education and services.
  
 To prepare the institution for national and international accreditation.
  
 To foster innovation, research, and development in teaching and learning.
  
 To organize capacity-building programs for faculty and staff.
  
 To establish effective feedback mechanisms for quality improvement.
  
 To ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
 Functions of IQAC
 Quality Assurance: Monitoring and evaluating academic and administrative processes to ensure quality standards.
 Accreditation: Facilitating the institution’s preparation for NAAC, NBA, and other accreditation processes.
 Feedback Mechanisms: Collecting and analyzing feedback from students, faculty, and stakeholders for continuous improvement.
 Documentation: Maintaining records of quality-related activities and initiatives
 Training and Development: Organizing workshops, seminars, and training programs for faculty and staff.
 Best Practices: Identifying and implementing innovative practices to enhance institutional performance.
 Research Promotion: Encouraging research activities that contribute to academic excellence.

 Department Profile
 “Reading maketh a full man and writing an exact man.” For both reading and writing, our library resources are abundant and very much relevant. The college library is accommodated in a spacious separate floor. It has an air-conditioned reading room with more than 65000 books in stock in addition to books available in the department libraries. The regular subscription of 21 Indian journals adds to the stock of the central and departmental libraries.
 Role of Library Advisory Committee
 The advisory committee of the library is comprised of the principal, librarian, and faculty representation of one each from the science and humanities streams. The committee allocates funds to various departments from a state government funds to autonomous and UGC funds. The committee makes suggestions to make the library, an easily accessible source of knowledge for all kinds of students. The committee approves the steps taken to enhance the facilities of the library.

 Introduction 
 Sri Meenakshi Government Arts College for Women(A) was established by the Government of Tamilnadu in the temple city of Madurai in the year 1965, to fulfill the need for the upliftment of women in and around Madurai. Set in a sprawling campus of 16 acres, the college began its journey with 320 students and 13 teaching and 13 non-teaching staff members. Today, the college stands upgraded to Grade-I status and is well-placed among the 14 Grade-I colleges in the state of Tamil Nadu.

 Our Courses 
 Tamil 
 The Department of Tamil was established in the year 1966. In addition to offering part-I Tamil to all the students of the undergraduate program, the Department also offers B.A., Tamil & M.A., Tamil. B. A Tamil has been offered since 1966 and an M.A Tamil has been offered since 2013.
 View More 
 English 
 The Department of English, the pride of the Institution, has been part of it, ever since its inception and has a rich heritage of 50 years of service in teaching English at the Part II level. It looks with pride at the accomplished track record set over the years by the enthusiastic faculty members.
 View More 
 History 
 The Department of History was established in 1969 with an undergraduate course in History In 1975 M.A History was introduced. In 2014, the department was upgraded to a Research Department with M.Phil and Ph.D. (Full-time and Part-time) programs. Our Department has 13 sanctioned faculty positions. Among them, 10 faculty members possess a Doctorate Degree.
 View More 
 Economics 
 The Department of Economics came in to being as a distinct unit in 1966-67. The Department started UG Course in 1966-67, Post-Graduate Course in 1975-76 and M.Phil in 2013-14.The Department of Economics is one of the oldest of the Departments in the college and it has made a qualitative contribution to research and under and post graduate education in Economics since its initiation.
 View More 
 Commerce 
 The Department of Commerce was established as a separate entity in [Year — please provide if known]. The Department introduced the Undergraduate Programme in [UG Year], the Postgraduate Programme in [PG Year], and began offering M.Phil. in [M.Phil Year]. As one of the longstanding departments of the college, the Department of Commerce has consistently contributed to academic excellence through its dedicated focus on teaching, learning, and research in commerce and business-related disciplines.
 View More 
 Mathematics 
 The Department of Mathematics has been offering B.Sc Mathematics since 1966 and M.Sc Mathematics since 1980. The department has an enterprising faculty team and an enriched academic ambiance for the students. Six of the faculty have a Ph.D. Three of them are recognized research guides of Madurai Kamaraj University.
 View More 
 Physics 
 The Department of UG Physics was established in the year 1970-71 and PG Physics in 2013-14 with full strength. The department strives to provide quality education to make the students competent in all aspects with the help of well-qualified, committed, and experienced faculty members.
 View More 
 Chemistry 
 Chemistry is the most fascinating subject that deals with every aspect of our life. It nurtures students from various disciplines and hence has been a subject of maximum demand. The knowledge gained through the study of chemistry opens many career pathways.
 View More 
 Botany 
 There was a humble beginning of the Botany department with only Ancillary subjects. The then Botanical faculty intended that knowledge of plant science is necessarily infused in the minds of students. Thereby everyone understood what is what about Botany. Later on in the year 1995,
 View More 
 Zoology 
 The Department of Zoology was established in the year 1971 with Tamil and English as a medium of instruction. With 50 students at the beginning, the department has been flourishing for the past 48 years imparting knowledge, social skills, and ethics. The department is keen on providing a synergistic environment for academic upliftment and accepting social changes.
 View More 
 Geography 
 The Department of Geography was established in the year 1968 with a UG course and in the year in 1971 with a PG course. At present department has 6 Regular staff members 2 Guest Lecturers and 1 PTA Guest Lecturers and 259 UG and 29 PG students among its various academic ventures. It produces so many scholars and creates more professionals in various fields.
 View More 
 Home Science 
 The Department of Home Science with its early beginnings in 1979-1980 has offered a B.Sc. Home Science with specialization in Child Care and Preschool Education till 1999-2000. Keeping in view the bright career prospects in the health, nutrition, and food industries, the department reframed the curriculum and offered a B.Sc.
 View More 
 Computer Science 
 The Department of Computer Science was established in the year 1993 with a B.SC in Computer Science. In the academic year 2007-2008, B.Sc Computer Science (Shift II) was started and introduced M.Sc Computer Science in 2017, M. Phil Computer Science, and Ph.D. Computer Science during the academic year 2018 – 2019.
 View More 
 Computer Applications 
 The Department of Computer Applications blossomed in the year 1998 offering a Master of Computer Applications course approved by AICTE. In August 2018 BCA course was started. The Department has an enterprising faculty team of 3 Assistant professors . 2 Guest faculties and 1 programmer. It has more than 100 research publications to its credit.
 View More 
 Business Administration 
 BBA program Was introduced in a Academic year 2017-18 of Sri Meenakshi Govt. Arts College for Women(A) was initiated in the year 2004 with a broad vision to impart management knowledge by continuous updating of syllabi and interaction with corporations for enhancing employability among rural women students.

 Objectives of IQAC
  
 To develop a system for continuous improvement in academic and administrative performance.
  
 To promote quality enhancement initiatives and institutionalize best practices.
  
 To ensure stakeholder satisfaction through high-quality education and services.
  
 To prepare the institution for national and international accreditation.
  
 To foster innovation, research, and development in teaching and learning.
  
 To organize capacity-building programs for faculty and staff.
  
 To establish effective feedback mechanisms for quality improvement.
  
 To ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
 Functions of IQAC
 Quality Assurance: Monitoring and evaluating academic and administrative processes to ensure quality standards.
 Accreditation: Facilitating the institution’s preparation for NAAC, NBA, and other accreditation processes.
 Feedback Mechanisms: Collecting and analyzing feedback from students, faculty, and stakeholders for continuous improvement.
 Documentation: Maintaining records of quality-related activities and initiatives
 Training and Development: Organizing workshops, seminars, and training programs for faculty and staff.
 Best Practices: Identifying and implementing innovative practices to enhance institutional performance.
 Research Promotion: Encouraging research activities that contribute to academic excellence.

 Department Profile
 “Reading maketh a full man and writing an exact man.” For both reading and writing, our library resources are abundant and very much relevant. The college library is accommodated in a spacious separate floor. It has an air-conditioned reading room with more than 65000 books in stock in addition to books available in the department libraries. The regular subscription of 21 Indian journals adds to the stock of the central and departmental libraries.
 Role of Library Advisory Committee
 The advisory committee of the library is comprised of the principal, librarian, and faculty representation of one each from the science and humanities streams. The committee allocates funds to various departments from a state government funds to autonomous and UGC funds. The committee makes suggestions to make the library, an easily accessible source of knowledge for all kinds of students. The committee approves the steps taken to enhance the facilities of the library.
